name: TAB house photography
why: The guide requires real-looking photography of business owners at work (boardrooms, visible diversity) and forbids flat illustration, sepia and script aesthetics. AI output is text-free by design: logos and copy are always layered on top in the HTML templates.
style: Documentary-style editorial photograph, shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens at f/2.8, soft natural window daylight, true-to-life skin texture, candid unposed moment. Color palette of cool neutrals: navy and mid-blue clothing accents, white walls, light wood, a single small warm accent at most; natural, not oversaturated, no teal-orange grading. Modern but unpretentious mid-size business setting in the United States. Real people of varied ages (35 to 65), visibly diverse in ethnicity and gender.
avoid: No text, no lettering, no signage, no logos, no watermarks, no screens with readable content, no sepia, no vintage film look, no illustration, no 3D render look, no plastic skin, no extra fingers, no stock-photo grins at the camera.
